annotations.title: Ask to withdraw a version from App Review

description: Asks a person to approve taking an iOS version out of App Review (App Store Connect's Remove from review): Ploa cancels its review submission and waits until Apple shows the version as Developer Rejected, editable again, with its build still on TestFlight. Pass the release of any build of that version. To send a newer build in its place in one step, use ploa_release_submit_review with replace: true instead. Nothing changes at Apple until a person approves on the Ploa dashboard; check it with ploa_approval_status. Needs a token allowed to submit.

releaseId.description: The release ID that ploa_release_start returned.

name: ploa_release_withdraw_review
